note: The 3 voice registers and the prosody for each -- your tuning surface. Register 1 is the chill floor (known good). Registers 2 and 3 are what the bench drives so you can HEAR the Mickey Mouse (too high/squeaky) and Naruto (too dramatic) voices, then tune them here. kokoro_slot = the timbre blend (0..4 in register-voices.bin). speed/bright/gain = Kokoro prosody knobs. exaggeration = the Chatterbox expressive dial. Expressive OFF clamps everything to register 1. Edit and re-run the bench to tune.
